name: com.macxrbridge.xr
description: Unity Play Mode on a Meta Quest 3 from an Apple Silicon Mac, like Quest Link on Windows: passthrough, anchors, MRUK room with labels, the passthrough camera (PCA), environment depth and raycasts, headset audio and microphone, microgestures. Plus tools Quest Link doesn't have: session record and replay without the headset, deterministic perception tests, mixed reality recording, a live spectator stream, an in-headset debug view and an Editor command bridge for scripts and agents. Needs the MacXR Bridge runtime: https://github.com/edsonsims/macxr-bridge
